Looking at this problem, I need to find meeting times that work for all 6 people, accounting for timezone differences and individual constraints.

- Olivia and Karen can miss last 10 minutes
- Rachel needs 10 minutes free before the meeting
- Victoria has lunch 12:30-13:00 on Wednesday
- Charlotte can clear 9:00-9:45 if needed
